results.question: when does the marketplace go quiet during the year?
results.sql:
SELECT c.semester,
       c.period,
       c.academic_year,
       COUNT(*) AS total_activity
FROM nlq.calendar c
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON c.day = l.listed_on
JOIN nlq.deals d ON c.day = d.completed_on
GROUP BY c.semester, c.period, c.academic_year
ORDER BY c.semester, c.period;
